This includes harmful and beneficial alignment-dependent effects. It does not include every act of an aligned source, ordinary attacks, faction standing, actual membership, ownership, ordinary character development/conduct, acquisition history, an intrinsic protected source engine, or unrelated components of a mixed effect. Read the actual predicate; titles, schools, faith, appearance and ancestry are not tests. No invented base/rider decomposition is allowed where the source does not supply one.

Alignment Suggestion's changed-axis overlay and Alignment Purge's Neutral overlay cannot newly establish on this bearer. Alignment Lock and both actual Alignment Anchor modes' alignment snapshot expressions are protected alignment components; a new such component cannot establish. Alignment Anchor's conduct veto is covered only where its actual condition mechanically depends on protected alignment; independent established conduct restrictions are not erased by a thematic title. A new blocked control component spends no guard. Existing still-live Suggestion, Purge, Lock/Anchor alignment expressions are NEW suppressed, not cured or deleted. RW149-F. Preserve separate native school placements, not a benefit union. NEW select by actual acquired class school: Abjuration is a fixed 20-foot-RADIUS sphere centered at a perceived point within 20 feet; Universal retains its explicit fixed 10-foot-radius sphere and center within 10 feet. NEW concentration, maximum 60 elapsed seconds; this supplies a finite field rather than treating Instantaneous as permanence. No following aura, physical cover, pressure or rank ceiling.

NEW expressly adopt the Lesser local-expression domain for THIS identity: actual spells and explicitly magical nonspell/item expressions are suppressed at their real manifestation body/anchor/area, not every supernatural-sounding noun. A creature-attached spell expression is wholly suppressed while any part of its body intersects operative volume; an extended area loses only intersecting portions unless its exact source is indivisible. A magic item retains its mundane body, ownership, actual contents and physical custody while magical access/enhancements/actions are unavailable. Already completed damage, healing, injuries, ordinary permanent material changes, knowledge, prior movement and consumed resources persist. An ongoing magical form or animation follows its exact accepted body/gear/resumption contract; missing profiles are held rather than inventing reversion/deletion. A temporary-HP expression that is actually magical becomes unavailable only under its real suppression rules; its remaining pool, grant history and original deadline never refill. Ordinary RP, Dissonance engines and intrinsic nonmagical traits are not erased. Oracle's intrinsic Curse engine and Wizard Spell Preservation's primary-book protection remain protected exceptions; suppressed magical book use creates no ordinary destruction loophole.

NEW RW149-F-PAIR is limited to this Antimagic Field identity's two school modes and accepted Antimagic Field (Lesser). This expressly extends the Lesser same-family rule only to this pair, without rewriting Lesser's behavior against any other source. No rank-based winner, recursion or iteration-dependent oscillation. A second actual qualified caster can establish its field inside the first after full payment/components/concentration/cadence and cast-time counter opportunity. The field payload is exempt; unrelated spells by that caster are not. Losing either source's concentration/clock ends only that source. The exemption is not double concentration or immunity for dispel payloads.

NEW explicitly adopt AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04 for this identity. Legal casts inside still commit; an originating-inside ordinary magical payload is suppressed, without a queued future release. An outside-origin instantaneous payload checks its actual local recipient/area/destination; damage/healing inside creates no packet/root/rider. Indivisible teleport/placement with an inside destination footprint fails atomically at origin after cost, while outside-to-outside nonpath travel ignores an imaginary line through the sphere. Genuine projectile paths retain the source's actual semantics. A concentrating caster entering does not remotely suppress an outside effect. NEW for this Rank8 field alone, its fixed creation center is its discrete whole-application termination locus. directorProcedureRecord.commonProcedure:
WARD5-COMMON-149. This is static authored operational review of these five identities only. Preserve the complete native catalog record, original questions, school placements, class rows and historical metadata beside the new procedure. An Instantaneous source field remains in that evidence; a finite maintained ward lifetime below is an expressly NEW resolution, not recovered canon. No extra school access, generic upcast, class acquisition, feat, sourceStatus migration or canonical catalog/index write follows.

All five keep Action, V/S/F, native rank 8, base 21 RP and minimum class level 15. Use the actual casting class's ability, repertoire/preparation, school and additional costs: Cleric and Druid use Wisdom; Mage and Wizard use Intelligence, subject only to an actual sourced substitution. Spell attacks are d20 + PB + that modifier, and spell DC is 8 + PB + that modifier plus only genuinely acquired applicable source bonuses. None of these five admissions adds a save merely to use that DC. Antilife Shell has Cleric/Druid/Wizard routes only; the other four also have Mage. Perceive the recipient or chosen center, meet the native range and caster line of effect, have a usable somatic hand and actual focus, and be able to perform verbal components. A known absent legal target, inaccessible mode or unavailable action fails before payment. Private eligibility resolves after legal commitment, without a free diagnosis or refund. No save is added to these five NEW admission procedures. Recipient wards require actual willingness; an unconscious creature cannot newly consent. Previously established protection does not require continued consciousness.

Use the bound ordinary casting contract: determine final price from pre-cast Dissonance, then commit costs, Action, components and any concentration transition; update the actual class's first-family/base Dissonance and same-name Refrain exactly once at beginning; open legal cast-time counters; surviving payload resolves afterward. A countered or suppressed paid cast retains costs, cadence and displaced concentration. Readying pays/starts concentration at preparation and releases through the actual Reaction/trigger before its original deadline, without a second payment, cast or counter window. A required concentration spell uses the one real slot and ends on actual loss, incapacitation or source death. No ward receives a free extra action, start, recovery, rest, resource pool or hard-control allowance.

Each application has a unique cast/application ID, original source character/class/school/rank, recipient or fixed center, creation timestamp, original deadline, concentration owner if any, and actual suppression and termination causes. Half-open lifetimes [establishment,deadline): expiry wins at the deadline. Clocks continue through suppression, absence, reorder and scene transitions. Explicit elapsed-second lifetimes below override generic round conversion. Recasts are real new paid casts. For each recipient-ward identity, NEW at most one established application per recipient across casters/modes: a genuinely established eligible replacement ends the previous same-identity ward; a failed/countered/suppressed-before-establishment cast replaces nothing. Ordinary concentration displacement is independent. Separate fixed area casts have independent original identities; no stacked force, damage or clock reset. There is no new voluntary area dismissal permission; ending concentration where required follows the accepted interface. NEW a willing recipient may end its own Alignment Immunity or Mind Blank without an Action during its actual regular turn; it cannot waive one protected component while retaining the same ward. Ended wards do not restart without a new cast.

Newly prevented components create no dormant application, owed damage or guard claim. Suppression of a previously established eligible expression preserves its source record, original clock, used control guard, spent costs/actions and original damage roots. Resume only a still-live expression, with then-current lawful prerequisites and no missed ticks, commands, saves, healing, temporary-HP refill or repeated initial consequence. Existing consequences are not retroactively undone; a currently resumed Incapacitated component does end any genuinely new incompatible concentration, without refunding or repeating historical losses. Source ending while suppressed remains terminal. Actual positive damage, CON concentration saves and source-sensitive endings still use their own rules. These ward entry rules are not whole-Action denial and spend no hard-control guard.

Keep public observation separate from director-only predicates. A stopped body or unavailable information can be observed normally; no exact hidden alignment, score, membership, immunity cause, creature type or remote location is automatically published. Unresolved authoritative facts are explicit whole-case/branch holds, never fabricated successful campaign examples. A hidden fact that an actual authoritative campaign ledger possesses can be resolved privately; an auditor lacking that ledger cannot certify its positive case. Current index/receipts supersede old preparation labels calling already-applied cohorts pending; preserve those labels as historical evidence only. All inherited source/content/access/physical/cosmology/runtime holds remain; no whole-domain, runtime, human-play, balance or release approval is made.
directorProcedureRecord.procedure:
RW149-F. Preserve separate native school placements, not a benefit union. NEW select by actual acquired class school: Abjuration is a fixed 20-foot-RADIUS sphere centered at a perceived point within 20 feet; Universal retains its explicit fixed 10-foot-radius sphere and center within 10 feet. The ambiguous Abjuration '20-ft sphere' is expressly resolved as radius, not asserted to have printed that word. Every current class route is Abjuration; Universal has no current access grant and its use stays unavailable/held. Both use caster line of effect to center and a volume clipped by actual solid total cover from center. NEW concentration, maximum 60 elapsed seconds; this supplies a finite field rather than treating Instantaneous as permanence. No following aura, physical cover, pressure or rank ceiling.

NEW expressly adopt the Lesser local-expression domain for THIS identity: actual spells and explicitly magical nonspell/item expressions are suppressed at their real manifestation body/anchor/area, not every supernatural-sounding noun. A creature-attached spell expression is wholly suppressed while any part of its body intersects operative volume; an extended area loses only intersecting portions unless its exact source is indivisible. A magic item retains its mundane body, ownership, actual contents and physical custody while magical access/enhancements/actions are unavailable. Already completed damage, healing, injuries, ordinary permanent material changes, knowledge, prior movement and consumed resources persist. An ongoing magical form or animation follows its exact accepted body/gear/resumption contract; missing profiles are held rather than inventing reversion/deletion. A temporary-HP expression that is actually magical becomes unavailable only under its real suppression rules; its remaining pool, grant history and original deadline never refill. Ordinary RP, Dissonance engines and intrinsic nonmagical traits are not erased. Oracle's intrinsic Curse engine and Wizard Spell Preservation's primary-book protection remain protected exceptions; suppressed magical book use creates no ordinary destruction loophole.

NEW RW149-F-PAIR is limited to this Antimagic Field identity's two school modes and accepted Antimagic Field (Lesser). Their suppression-field expressions and required maintenance connection do not suppress one another or themselves; independently active volumes combine for payload checks. This expressly extends the Lesser same-family rule only to this pair, without rewriting Lesser's behavior against any other source. No rank-based winner, recursion or iteration-dependent oscillation. A second actual qualified caster can establish its field inside the first after full payment/components/concentration/cadence and cast-time counter opportunity. The field payload is exempt; unrelated spells by that caster are not. Losing either source's concentration/clock ends only that source. The exemption is not double concentration or immunity for dispel payloads.

NEW explicitly adopt AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04 for this identity. Legal casts inside still commit; an originating-inside ordinary magical payload is suppressed, without a queued future release. An outside-origin instantaneous payload checks its actual local recipient/area/destination; damage/healing inside creates no packet/root/rider. Indivisible teleport/placement with an inside destination footprint fails atomically at origin after cost, while outside-to-outside nonpath travel ignores an imaginary line through the sphere. Genuine projectile paths retain the source's actual semantics. A concentrating caster entering does not remotely suppress an outside effect. Ready/delayed release is checked at its actual manifestation time, retains preparation costs/original timer and grants no second cast or banked suppressed release.

Removal operations are not exempt ordinary spell payloads. Capture a legal dispel's immutable source-specific effect set, then capture suppression of EACH termination operation before any removal. An operation targeting a field ignores only that SAME field's suppression; a different field may still suppress the operation at its actual locus/origin. NEW for this Rank8 field alone, its fixed creation center is its discrete whole-application termination locus. A source-qualified area dispel can still capture an exposed portion under its original selection rule; suppression of this field's indivisible ending checks its fixed center and the real dispeller origin, ignoring only the target field. Partial overlap away from both points does not protect this field from termination. This does not redefine another spell's locus or capture scope. Resolve only nonsuppressed captured operations, with their real rank/cost/check; never rescan after an earlier removal. Wizard Arch Dispel Magic is its actual rank 3, Action, 3 RP, range 60, recharge 2, INT+PB versus 10+target rank above rank 3; it is not Greater Dispel. An acquired ordinary Greater Dispel is rank 5/base10/range30/30-foot area with rank6–9 checks versus10+2rank, only where actual access/preparation and accepted authority are proved. Counterspell is cast-time only and cannot terminate an already existing field. Arcane Sight or another genuinely operating perception source must supply actual effect perception; a suppressed sense does not conveniently see its own target. Capture set/suppression before changes in field order. Simultaneous outer deadlines use their recorded ordering, not a new removal scan.

NEW explicit five-profile extension of the already accepted AC5/AC6 same-body suppression lifecycles to THIS field: Greater Fire Pet, Faction Champion, Greater Air Pet, Greater Planar Ally and each Faction Army soldier retain their same IDs, HP, current positions, Null state, true cargo/custody and original source deadlines. Full body intersection suppresses source-provided Speed/actions/attacks/commands/traits; independently genuine cargo remains and drops only if actual custody fails. Greater Air Pet's suppressed fly/hover permits genuine Falling. Source ending while suppressed still ends that source; resumption never resummons/heals/refills or replays commands. This is an explicit named bridge, not a universal summon rule. Other actually accepted profiles use their own supplied contracts only when their predicates authorize it; source-packet comparison labels alone grant nothing.

For ordinary Banishment and the two expressly bridged AC5 exiles Banish Elemental/Elemental Banishment, NEW this field invokes their existing close-on-actual-application-suppression lifecycle, preserving origin anchors, IDs, surviving cargo and mandatory terminal placement. The field must actually reach the application locus; the distant caster's presence does not project suppression into a cell. No new planes, endpoint topology, generic banishment of summons, resurrection, duplicated body or blanket terminal bypass is authored. Missing source/physical/cosmology facts remain whole-case or branch holds.

completeAcceptedProcedure.procedure:
RW149-M. KEEP Action/120 feet/V/S/F/rank8/base21 and all three printed placements. NEW one willing perceived creature, no save, no concentration, for 3,600 elapsed seconds. This one-hour duration is Ward5 authorship, not an imported 24-hour convention. A living 0-HP bearer retains established protection; NEW terminal death/identity ending ends it, with no automatic restoration after a later lawful return. Actual current Cleric/Druid/Mage/Wizard access selects Abjuration only; Enchantment and Universal are preserved, fully specified conditional modes, unavailable absent a future exact class-access source. No free union or mode switch.

Abjuration prevents psychic damage from every actual psychic packet, newly acquired divination information about the bearer, and recipient components of actual mind-affecting SPELLS. NEW mind-affecting means mechanically reading/writing a recipient's thoughts or memories, imposing emotion, private mental perception, belief, mental compulsion or mental capacity/attention impairment, determined from the actual operational component. An actual Abjuration divination protection also stops nonspell sources expressly classified as divination; it does not turn all class magic into spells. Genuine nonspell mind reading is protected in Abjuration only when it is actually divination; a nondivinatory nonspell mental attack is not covered by 'spells' merely by its title. Enchantment prevents psychic damage, actual mind reading regardless of spell/nonspell, and actual imposed emotion regardless of spell/nonspell; it does not gain general divination, memory/compulsion or mental-capacity immunity. Universal prevents psychic damage and actual mind reading only. Ordinary persuasion, sight/hearing, languages, voluntary reasoning, personality, skills and nonmental physical conditions persist.

NEW Abjuration information boundary: a divinatory channel obtains no fresh protected bearer facts—identity, current location/body observation, alignment, mind contents or directly predicted future state—from that bearer or a remote observation/query of the bearer. A room scry can truthfully show independently observable room/other-creature facts, but not newly resolve the bearer's protected image/location; it cannot truthfully report 'empty' or a made-up substitute when the protected fact is required. A prediction causally involving the bearer may report independently supported facts, but must withhold any dependent assertion that would certify the protected bearer's state. No all-world blindness. A real witness's preexisting memory or an existing written record is a different source: ordinary reading, testimony and even independently legal divination of THAT witness's historical recollection may reveal what the witness remembers, explicitly as a historical report rather than magically verified current truth about the bearer. It must not access the bearer as a validation/updates channel. A currently warded witness's own thoughts are protected when that mode covers the reading. Already learned knowledge/records remain; this ward is prospective protection, not universal history redaction. Blocked outputs give no false fact or exact immunity diagnosis.

NEW exact component classification for the accepted comparisons: Dominate Person's mental control is covered by Abjuration; Erase Emotion's imposed emotion (including its source-linked fear/rage prohibitions) is covered by Abjuration and Enchantment. Phantasmal Killer's private mental nightmare/fear components are covered by Abjuration; its fear is also covered by Enchantment's emotion clause. Greater Phantasmal Killer's private nightmare is covered by Abjuration but imports no fear. Hypnotic Pattern's mental Charmed/Incapacitated components are covered by Abjuration; Enchantment protects the Charmed emotion component, not an independently specified Incapacitated component. Mental Bomb's mental Reaction-debt and Synaptic Static's mental roll penalty are expressly classified here as mind-affecting spell components for Abjuration; they are not emotion or mind-reading components for the other modes. In every mode actual psychic damage is independently zero. No psychic-only rule removes a separately unprotected control component. A physical/sensory illusion in the world remains visible and may deceive ordinary agency; a real weapon wielded by a deceived actor deals its actual nonpsychic damage normally. School labels alone classify none of these.

NEW eligible fresh components are prevented before establishment/guard expenditure; existing covered live components are suppressed, not cured. Preserve original controller, order expiry, saves where the source still requires them, concentration, clock, original damage root and hard-guard/spent-action histories. No initial prevented component springs into existence on expiry. If an existing mental control resumes, it uses its original still-valid order, never a banked expired command; an already-incapacitating component again prevents newly attempted actions and ends genuinely new incompatible concentration. A previously lost concentration is never restored. This immunity is not a restoration spell for a completed memory rewrite: it blocks future writes and suppresses only independently ongoing eligible expressions.

Friendly one-way telepathy and dream communication that deliver a message without reading or altering the recipient's mind remain legal; thought extraction, forced implanted memory, imposed emotion or actual divination still meet the selected mode's protection even when friendly, self-cast or desired. Consent is not a per-component bypass. The recipient may use the explicit whole-ward ending permission in WARD5-COMMON, then a genuinely new legal effect can apply; no old prevented cast replays. Source-specific dream-plane access and body safety remain held where absent, without invented cosmology.

common.holds: Source/access/content/form/body geometry/identity topology/runtime/human-play/balance/release holds survive this return. rules.eligibility: NEW one willing living physical creature-origin identity with a documented reproducible persistent root body. Perceive the source within120ft/LoE and designate a legal unoccupied growth envelope adjacent to it and also within120ft/LoE, same established plane. No printed vessel, blood sample, gem or extra price is added. Physical Constructs are not automatically excluded if actually living/reproducible by their own source; HP-only animations, transformed objects and temporary summoned bodies gain no Clone eligibility by appearance. Unknown reproduction/physiology holds the whole dependent branch. Validate the entire root body envelope, mass and missing parts, excluding temporary form anatomy and gear.
rules.growth: NEW the paid instantaneous cast produces one full-size inert immature physical duplicate at that anchor; it never acts, has no personal identity, inventory, class resources or companion slot. Maturity at createdAt+86400elapsedseconds, phase0 before a new death check at equality. No concentration; clock continues in antimagic. The magical rank8 insurance link persists until consumed, replaced, destroyed with the body, or actually ended by a source-qualified dispel. Caster death alone does not end it. Physical matter is not a maintained magical body and does not vanish in suppression.
rules.body: NEW dormant replacement body uses object-like structural AC10 and20structuralHP, no resistance, immunity, regeneration or separate personal HP pool. At structural0 it is destroyed and its entitlement ends. The intact viable-return gate requires structuralHP20 and no new anatomy/storage damage; partial damage blocks return until actual applicable repair restores structural20 and anatomy. Structural repair never heals the source character. rules.claim: NEW resolve one atomic claim of the eligible body and identity, consume entitlement once, retire the dormant structuralHP pool (retain its historical damage record but it is no longer an active pool), then assign life1normalHP with present lawful maximum and protected lethal-track handling from the later healing/death closure. rules.statisticsJustification: NEW choose only the accepted Ghoul comparison’s fixed40HP/13AC/six scores/movement/attack/rider, never the strongest four-profile result. NEW snapshot original caster attack/DC/PB at creation instead of that comparison’s continuing caster-stat dependency, so permanent independent body needs no dead creator lookup. Copy exact numbers into the new actor. Original person remains dead; memories, personality, classes, magical training, resources, ownership and soul are not transferred. Unrated mechanical Undead is not a cosmological soul assertion.
rules.agency: NEW no automatic caster control, loyalty, hostility, work order, wages or companion command allowance. Independent actor has no turn in creation round; first independent opportunity is the next numbered round at a fixed virtual slot immediately after the original caster’s captured regular slot, then once each numbered round, regardless of creator initiative change/death. It receives ordinary Action/movement/Bonus Action/Reaction only when a source grants usable actions; no Extra Attack or special reaction. Actual goals/content/needs must be supplied before campaign use, otherwise the agency-dependent branch is held. Explicit fixture goal is test input, not granted by the spell.
rules.persistence: Physical conversion is permanent and survives original caster loss, ordinary antimagic and link dispel. Only the slow rider is magical/nonspell and suppressible; generic spell-only dispel does not erase the physical body or a nonspell rider. Completed0structuralHP destroys the HP-only animation and leaves consumed unusable-for-new-animation remains and real gear; no Wounds/death-save or ordinary living healing engine unless another exact source grants it. No new corpse, XP, resource, harvest or resurrection-target farm follows. Actual applicable physical damage/healing/repair/needs require sources; Undead does not imply no food/air/water/sleep.
rules.nullAndReturn: NEW explicitly extend the named animation NullDisabled rule: a qualifying damage-root Nonlethal effect on this HP-only animation leaves it inert at0, not destroyed; identity-specific disabling and recovery require the actual Null source. No generic nondamage prevention follows. Future attacks use the animation as damage owner; original caster Null is not inherited. Later true resurrection is governed by its exact identity/body requirements and current claims; no body can be allocated twice. This spell gives no new personal soul binding, compelled service, CR-based command access or cosmology.

Their full native records and complete accepted procedures/shared rules are embedded below unchanged. This is explicit spell-local acquisition for the shade, not a claim that the owner knows/prepares them or has another class. For Chill Touch preserve the creating-class source placement: Wizard Evocation, Cleric/Druid Necromancy; all deal native necrotic damage. rules.fundingAndCadence: Each child spell is genuinely cast by the shade at its attached commanded Action. Before committing, require actual component anatomy,target,rank,shade Dissonance legality and owner available RP. Pay the original owner pool the full child base plus shade strain surcharge and any actual child-source extras, never an owner discount/surcharge/metamagic; owner must still exist with that actually spendable pool. No personal shade RP pool or credit. Shade owns Dissonance/Refrain/lastFamily with ordinary base0/1/1,limit=max(4,2+snapshotPB+max(0,shadeINTmod)); no Wizard first-family exemption, class proc or Arcane Feedback. Failed/countered paid child keeps command/offense,cost and strain; a known unfundable attempt creates no cast and its issued command expires in that phase. Owner has no second cast/cadence/hit/heal/kill event. Recasting a genuinely new shade costs the full parent21RP and ends old parent/child; it creates a finite new shade cadence record only, never refunds ownerRP,used owner round allowance,world assets or existing persistent riders.
rules.childConcentration: Owner owns parent concentration; shade separately owns at most one child concentration. Casting Enervation starts shade concentration at child commitment, ending an old child before counters/outcome, never owner parent. Vampiric Touch is the exact instantaneous3d6 touch spell, not an invented concentration repeat attack. Chill Touch is actual Touch,not a ranged imported card. Enervation is actual60ft ranged4d8 pulse,60second channel,max10pulses; follow-up maintenance consumes a later real BA command plus the shade single attached Action and shared offense allowance, but no new RP/cast/Refrain. No spare owner Action or extra turn buys pulses. Own regular virtual cycle is original owner attached opportunity; if a future cycle receives no legal maintenance, end at its attached END. Loss of actual target continuity/range/perception/LoE,shade Incapacitated,death/ending,or full suppression ends channel immediately under its native source. Damage to shade tests its own child concentration with CONsave versus max(10,floor(damage/2)); damage to owner tests parent only. Parent ending removes shade and ends child before any later checkpoint. No orphaned beam/missed pulse replay.
rules.spellOwnership: Shade is actual caster/dealer/heal recipient. Each actual Enervation initial/maintenance attack creates a NEW damage root sampling the shade then-current Veil; subsequent pulses do not inherit an earlier attack root. The owner Veil is irrelevant. Genuine damage transfers preserve that root; healing sums only allowed terminal branches once,including actual tempHP absorbed where native Vampiric Touch/Enervation permit it,excluding overkill,no-derived-heal/no-recovery branches and duplicates. Do not graft the narrower native Drain filter onto these spells. Full damage/life/source-ending consequences precede healing; ended shade is not recreated. Child spell-specific independent timed riders, notably Chill Touch, keep their own endpoint after parent ending unless their own source requires caster persistence; this is not orphaned concentration or a stored pulse. No shade Reaction,Counterspell,Ready,spell copy or owner personal hook is granted.

After damage and source-ending callbacks, if the same shade remains, heal it floor(eligible actual normalHP lost/2) once under real ordinary healing rules. TemporaryHP loss,overkill,prevented loss and no-recovery/no-derived-healing branches contribute0. If no maintenance Action is completed during an available future regular turn, the channel ends at that turn's END; a miss still counts as maintenance.
